findings.title: Pane icon is the Eclor Waterfall icon
findings.expected: A matrix-specific 20×20 RGBA icon (CLAUDE.md gotcha: replace before Stage B)
findings.actual: assets/icon.png is 20×20 RGBA but byte-identical to eclor-waterfall/assets/icon.png (md5 99a8a60f…)
evidence: audit/screens/it3-open.png (new icon in the Visualizations pane) (it3: PASS)
findings.fixHint: Design is the user's call — needs a matrix glyph in the ECLOR style; the fixer should not invent branding
findings.fixNote: User approved the proposed glyph: 3x3 ink grid with an emerald header band, 20x20 RGBA. Guard test in test/manifest.test.ts.

findings.title: No min/max conditions on the matrix mapping
findings.expected: Microsoft case 'Check min/max dataViewMapping conditions': each bucket's cardinality intent encoded
findings.actual: dataViewMappings[0].conditions is absent — every role (including comments) accepts unlimited fields
evidence: audit/screens/it3-D-*.png (16 pages render with the conditions); field removal still in GEN-05 manual (it3: PASS)
findings.fixHint: Declare explicit conditions matching the intended cardinality (single mapping only — never a second mapping, CLAUDE.md)
findings.fixNote: Explicit min:0 on every role. Deviation: no min>=1, it would reintroduce the ghost frame (no dv.matrix -> replay). Auditor must re-check all pages still render.

findings.title: Custom column widths can only be set with the mouse
findings.expected: Every interactive feature reachable from the keyboard
findings.actual: Column grips are aria-hidden spans without tabindex; no keyboard path or Format-pane equivalent for individual widths
evidence: audit/screens/it3-A11Y-5-resized.png (Shift+Tab to the grip, 6 x right arrow in Desktop) (it3: PASS)
repro: Try to resize a column without a mouse
findings.fixHint: Make the grip focusable with arrow-key resizing, or expose per-column widths elsewhere
findings.fixNote: Grips are focusable separators: arrows resize, keyup persists, Delete resets, focus restored after the header rebuild. Host focus behaviour needs the browser lane.

findings.title: T04 waterfall cursor is not re-anchored between groups of a multi-level hierarchy
findings.expected: Each group's cascade connects to its own subtotal bar
findings.actual: waterfallStarts keeps one running cursor across groups while subtotal bars start at 0, so group N's detail bars start where group N-1 ended (single-level schemes such as the T04 page are correct)
evidence: audit/screens/it3-D-p15-t04-multi.png + test/ibcs.test.ts (bars too small on this data to read the join by eye) (it3: PASS)
repro: Compare the second segment's last detail bar end with its subtotal bar end
findings.fixHint: Reset or rebase the cursor at each group boundary so the cascade and subtotal agree
findings.fixNote: Subtotal bar spans its group's cascade (cum - v at the bottom, cum at the top); the cursor stays continuous.

findings.title: 'Blank column between groups' flattens the multi-level column header
findings.expected: Aeration columns keep the hierarchical header
findings.actual: buildRenderColumns returns a flat header as soon as gap columns are on, even without calc columns
repro: Grid & borders → Blank column between groups ON
findings.fixHint: Insert gap cells into the tree header rows instead of switching to the flat header
findings.fixNote: insertGapColumns threads gaps through the tree header. No page in the test report exercises it: the auditor needs a Year > Quarter gap page.

findings.title: Format-pane options are not localized (only card titles have displayNameKey)
findings.expected: Per project policy — eclor-waterfall shipped certified with English slice labels BY DESIGN, but eclor-matrix CLAUDE.md does not document that posture
findings.actual: 12 displayNameKey for 105 cards/slices; a French Desktop shows French card titles over English options
findings.fixHint: Decision needed: adopt the waterfall posture (document it in CLAUDE.md) or add keys + fr/en strings for every slice
findings.fixNote: User chose the eclor-waterfall posture; documented in CLAUDE.md as a critical design decision. No code change: auditor should record PASS (documented posture).

findings.title: supportsHighlight is not declared
findings.expected: Checklist expects the four cert flags; Microsoft only requires that selections in other visuals filter this one
findings.actual: Flag absent; the host therefore filters the matrix on cross-selection (GEN-04 verified working — same behaviour as the native matrix)
repro: Interactions page: click 'Government' in the bar chart
findings.fixHint: Decision needed: keep filter semantics (document why) or implement highlight rendering before declaring the flag
findings.fixNote: User chose to keep filter semantics; documented in CLAUDE.md. No code change: auditor should record PASS (documented posture).

findings.title: Column grip tooltip is hard-coded English
findings.expected: User-facing runtime strings go through the localization manager (36 other chrome strings do)
findings.actual: 'Drag to resize · double-click to reset' is a literal
repro: French Desktop, Column widths → Custom, hover a grip
findings.fixHint: Route through this.localize with en/fr resjson keys
findings.fixNote: Grip tooltip localized; locale parity and used-key guards added.

findings.title: No jest case for a measure bound to several roles at once
findings.expected: Playbook §4.3.2 role-iteration test: the same measure in Values + Tooltips (+ Comments) renders once in the grid and once in the tooltip
findings.actual: lifecycle.test.ts covers tooltip-only measures, not a measure carrying values AND tooltips/comments roles
repro: grep for a values+tooltips dual-role fixture in test/
findings.fixHint: Add the dual-role fixture; also add one where the first measure node has no levelSourceIndex (see GEN-25-a)
findings.fixNote: Tests added; they exposed a real gap (dual-role measure missing from sibling tooltips), fixed in buildTooltipItems.

findings.title: certification branch lags main (1.6.0.0 vs 1.11.1.0)
findings.expected: certification matches the build that will be submitted
findings.actual: origin/certification = 81796d4 (1.6.0.0); main = 762d9e0 (1.11.1.0). Not blocking before submission
findings.fixHint: Fast-forward certification once the audit loop reaches READY
findings.fixNote: Per the finding's own hint: fast-forward certification once the loop reaches READY.

findings.title: K-scaled values above 999K render without a group separator
findings.expected: Scaled values stay easy to read ("5,630K" or "5.6M")
findings.actual: Columns resolved to thousands show "5630K", "1555K", "1020K"; unscaled General-format numbers show "7352" (the latter matches the host formatter for a General column)
repro: Page Multi-instance, Nominal (3rd instance): Total row
findings.fixHint: When auto resolves to a unit for a measure without a model format, give the formatter a grouped pattern (#,0) or allow one decimal at the next unit
findings.fixNote: Opt-in groupScaled on formatActualLabel (format.ts delta flagged in CONTEXT §5). Also closes the calc-column residual of GEN-26-a.

findings.title: An explicit 'Top' subtotal position still renders a blank group row plus a separate Total row
findings.expected: With 'Top', the subtotal values sit on the group row itself, like the native matrix
findings.actual: Residual of GEN-25-b. The default is now Bottom, so only reports that choose Top see two rows per group
evidence: audit/screens/D-p05-nominal.png (it1, when Top was the default)
repro: Format > Subtotals > Row subtotal position = Top on page Nominal
findings.fixHint: Fold the subtotal onto the group row while keeping it selectable and out of the detail domains
